host_eligibility.value:
Applicants are nominated by their home university and managed within a partner-framework agreement. Before applying contact the International Office ( exchangestud uni-trier de ), which offers information about the application process via the Admissions Office, room availability and participation in German language Course.
Have you been nominated by your home university to study at Trier University? If so, let yourself be inspired by the variety of courses! At Trier University, you can expand your studies according to your wishes with a German perspective on your field of study and beyond. The Orientation Programme for international students makes it easier for you to settle into student life in Trier.
If you are a student participating in an exchange programme (e.g. ERASMUS, ISEP, partner universities) and have been nominated by your home university to study at Trier University, you will find information here on your application and admission to Trier University.
ⓘ Your application form is only valid if your home university has confirmed your nomination by signing and stamping your application form.

If you start your studies at Trier University in the winter semester , your application procedure starts in April of the same year. The application deadline is 1 June .
If you start your studies at Trier University in the summer semester , your application procedure starts in October of the previous year. The application deadline is 15 December .
If you start your studies at Trier University in the winter semester , your application procedure starts in April of the same year. The application deadline is 1 June .

course_restrictions.value:
Gather additional information on the courses offered by the subjects on the websites of the subjects for exchange students (there you will usually find course lists from the current semesters and information on credit allocation). These and the contact persons in the subjects, who you can also contact with specific questions about course selection, can be found here.
Language Courses: Would you also like to learn German or other languages at Trier University? Then take a look at the courses offered by the Language Centre. The Language Centre is part of the University and the courses are free of charge for all Trier University students. German Courses: Each semester, intensive courses as well as additional module courses are offered at various proficiency levels (typically A and B levels). If you have any questions about German courses, please contact: Ms. Zita van Wylick (ECTS Coordinator for German Courses). Registration for the courses and the placement test generally take place during the week before the start of the lecture period or the orientation program. A preliminary overview in English can be found here.
After arrival at Trier University, you will receive your Trier student ID card, the "Tunika". You will receive authorization to use the computers at the University, including instructions on how to access the Wi-Fi on campus, your own email address and the course catalogue (PORTA) well before arrival.
How to sign up for exams is covered on these pages: 🡒 Course selection 🡒 End of Stay

housing.value:
If you would like the International Office to arrange accommodation for you, please send us the "Application for Accommodation" in writing. You can find this form in the online application portal.
We can only arrange a room in a student hall of residence for you if you send us the "Auftrag zur Vermittlung einer Unterkunft" together with the "Antrag auf Zulassung". You can find it on our 🡒 Online Application Portal under "Housing". Rooms in halls of residence are allocated at the beginning of August for the following winter semester and at the end of January for the following summer semester. The order of the applications received by the International Office determines the allocation of the limited number of places. Information on the rental contract and handing over the keys can be obtained from the International Office. The monthly rent for a room in a student hall of residence is approximately 325-365 Euros. In addition, a one-time deposit of 600 Euros is required.
Most rooms/flats on the private housing market are unfurnished (unlike the student residences at Trier University and some privately run student residences). Some accommodation offers do not include a kitchen. It is advisable to clarify this before moving in.
In Germany, both private flats and dormitory rooms always have a cancellation notice period. This is usually specified in the contract and is typically around three months. It is not possible to move out early, so make sure you adhere to the notice period.

housing_costs.value:
Please note that in advance of your studies at Trier University, the financing for your complete stay in Germany must be clarified and secured. You will need at least 992 euros per month to finance your life in Trier. Most of the costs will be for rent, health insurance and your meals. In your first month, you will also have other costs. Usually you will have to pay a deposit for your flat. You will also have to pay the semester fee, which is currently around 380 euros. In order to apply for a visa, you will need to provide ⭷ proof of financial resources . In other words, you must prove that you can finance your studies in Trier.
Rent on the private housing market does not include utilities such as water, electricity or gas, and additional estate agent fees may apply when searching on the private housing market.
Is the rent for this type of flat realistic? • A room in a shared flat costs on average: 300–450€. • A one-room flat/studio costs 350–500€. • Furnished accommodation is more expensive than unfurnished.
above currently is around EUR 110 per month (reduced student fee).

transport.value:
Trier University is a campus university, meaning that all of its buildings and facilities are concentrated in a relatively small area and are easily accessible by foot. The main campus (Campus I) and Campus II are situated about ten minutes walk from each other and there is also a shuttle bus between the two. The buildings on Campus I are surrounded by landscaped parkland and lakes, with sport, leisure and shopping facilities all available nearby. Campus II also has its share of greenery and borders onto Trier’s science and technology park.
The departments of Geography, Geoscience, Computer Sciences and Business Information Systems are based on Campus II, the faculty of Catholic Theology is located in the E-building and downtown Trier. All other departments are found on Campus I. In your admission letter you will be informed of the departments to which you have been admitted.

reference_excerpts.value: We can only arrange a room in a student hall of residence for you if you send us the "Auftrag zur Vermittlung einer Unterkunft" together with the "Antrag auf Zulassung". You can find it on our 🡒 Online Application Portal under "Housing". Rooms in halls of residence are allocated at the beginning of August for the following winter semester and at the end of January for the following summer semester. The order of the applications received by the International Office determines the allocation of the limited number of places. Information on the rental contract and handing over the keys can be obtained from the International Office. The monthly rent for a room in a student hall of residence is approximately 325-365 Euros. In addition, a one-time deposit of 600 Euros is required.

reference_excerpts.value: Please note that in advance of your studies at Trier University, the financing for your complete stay in Germany must be clarified and secured. You will need at least 992 euros per month to finance your life in Trier. Most of the costs will be for rent, health insurance and your meals. In your first month, you will also have other costs. Usually you will have to pay a deposit for your flat. You will also have to pay the semester fee, which is currently around 380 euros. In order to apply for a visa, you will need to provide ⭷ proof of financial resources . In other words, you must prove that you can finance your studies in Trier.

reference_excerpts.value: Trier University is a campus university, meaning that all of its buildings and facilities are concentrated in a relatively small area and are easily accessible by foot. The main campus (Campus I) and Campus II are situated about ten minutes walk from each other and there is also a shuttle bus between the two. The buildings on Campus I are surrounded by landscaped parkland and lakes, with sport, leisure and shopping facilities all available nearby. Campus II also has its share of greenery and borders onto Trier’s science and technology park.

B. Living Cost: about 600 yuan every month.
第十四条 校奖生的生活费由学校按月发放。校奖生本人应在每月指定时间到海外教育学院签字确认奖学金发放表，无故未按时签字确认的，当月生活费停发且不予补发。
第十五条 奖学金生每学期初应当按时到校注册，未能按时到校注册的学生，应当办理请假手续，无故未到校报到的奖学金生，将暂停发放奖学金。新生的报到注册时间以录取通知书为准，毕业生的生活费发至学校确定毕业之日的当月。

housing_costs.value:
We recommend student accommodation for at least your first year of study, giving you time to settle into your new routine. We find that students who choose to live in student accommodation in the first year are generally better prepared to thrive in shared or private rental accommodation in subsequent years.
Most student accommodation comes fully furnished and equipped with essential resources for effective study. In most cases, utilities and wifi are connected, and these costs are included in your accommodation fee, making it easy for you to budget your finances.
Choosing where to live is one of the most important decisions you’ll make during your studies. While many students opt for student accommodation , Adelaide offers several alternatives including private rental, share accommodation and homestays. You can also access temporary accommodation in hostels, hotels and serviced apartments for short periods.
Private rental and share accommodation refer to residential properties available for rent, or individual bedrooms in established households.

Slovenians with no Slovenian citizenship receiving a scholarship by the Republic of Slovenia (Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia) may apply for a room at the Student resident halls. The Regulations on fees and accommodation in students’ dormitories for Slovene nationals without Slovene citizenship and foreigners in the Republic of Slovenia provide that up to 250 places are to be offered in Student resident halls for the recipients of ministry scholarship. Available places for the residence of scholarship recipients are assigned by the Ministry responsible for higher education in cooperation with scholarship providers. Recipients of ministry scholarships are charged a subsidized rent. The Ministry or scholarship provider pays the rent directly to the student dorm, i.e. from the scholarship amount granted.

About me Hello! My name is Una Lajić and I am currently in the last year of my undergraduate studies as a Marketing student at the School of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana. Since moving to Slovenia in 2023, I quickly integrated within the new environment, joining and becoming an active member of the student organisation of SEB LU all in the first week of my 1st year. Becoming an International Student Ambassador for the University of Ljubljana two years ago, I have actively taken on the responsibility of promoting and representing the institution, facilitating guidance to international students during the adaptation process regarding studies and integration into the new life in Slovenia. Taking into account that I have been in the same shoes you are currently in, facing numerous decisions ahead, knowing how difficult it is to leave your country, choose the right faculty and a place that you will call your new home, I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the university and student life here in Ljubljana!
Study program and level 3rd year undergraduate student in International Business at the Faculty of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana

reference_excerpts.value: Slovenians with no Slovenian citizenship receiving a scholarship by the Republic of Slovenia (Public Scholarship, Development, Disability and Maintenance Fund of the Republic of Slovenia) may apply for a room at the Student resident halls. The Regulations on fees and accommodation in students’ dormitories for Slovene nationals without Slovene citizenship and foreigners in the Republic of Slovenia provide that up to 250 places are to be offered in Student resident halls for the recipients of ministry scholarship. Available places for the residence of scholarship recipients are assigned by the Ministry responsible for higher education in cooperation with scholarship providers. Recipients of ministry scholarships are charged a subsidized rent. The Ministry or scholarship provider pays the rent directly to the student dorm, i.e. from the scholarship amount granted.

NB. If a “NO” button is selected, whilst the student is staying in an accredited accommodation, the student will be liable for the transport cost or it will be at his/her own account
The Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) is one of the largest residential educational institutions in South Africa. There are private student accommodation options, but first-year students should apply and register for University-owned accommodation, managed by ARLC. ARLC accommodation has the advantage of being on campus, or reliable transport provided by the University, if situated off campus. ARLC residences are furthermore well managed with experienced residence advisors, a strong governance system with many residence life opportunities organised by residence committees. There is furthermore a mentorship programme, according to which residents are placed according to course of study. Mentors are appointed for each resident to provide academic and mental well-being support.
When to apply for residence accommodation When a student applies for academic acceptance at TUT, they should also indicate their need for student accommodation. Applicants will be notified when they have been provisionally placed in a residence. Once a student has registered for academic study, he/she must register on-line in a residence to secure a space. Available spaces are filled on a first-come-first-served basis. With regard to residence application and registration, the following applies:

housing.value:
Living in the VMU Dormitory together with other international students
Accommodation The university accommodation is being organized by VMU Student Affairs Department. The accommodation information can be found HERE . The number of available places of VMU dormitory accommodation is limited and offered on a first come - first serve basis for the students who apply with the online accommodation form. The VMU Student Affairs Department opens the accommodation application form in July (for the autumn semester students) and in December (for the spring semester students). Health Insurance Health Insurance is one of the obligatory requirements for all international students at Vytautas Magnus University which should be taken care of before the students’ arrival. Please find the following information HERE . Visa Application Non-EU or non-EFTA country citizens should apply for multiple entry National visas (D). Please check the Visa Guide for more information. The prospective students are provided with the instructions sent by e-mail by VMU exchange coordinator. VMU Mentors' Programme VMU Mentor’s programme aims to make the adaptation process of incoming international students at Vytautas Magnus University (VMU) easier. Please find more information about this programme HERE . Learning Lithuanian Before visiting Lithuania you may want to learn how to say “hello”, “thank you”, “how could I find this and that” or maybe even more – to keep up a conversation in one of the oldest language in the world – Lithuanian. Please find the most useful information about Lithuanian learning possibilities HERE . Arrival and Registration at VMU All students are required to follow the information regarding the arrival and registration published HERE .
Rentum.eu is a free housing platform that matches suitable flats, rooms and potential flatmates in Lithuania.
Student Residence Hall ™ is a space where students can enjoy a superb lifestyle with the best rooms. This history building located in old city center. In 2022 it was renovated with love to include newly furnished attic rooms. The building has a completely equipped kitchens, studying and leisure zones, laundry rooms, and its own dedicated high speed wireless internet connection. All taxes and utilities (Wi-Fi, heating, electricity, gas, and water) are included in the rent price.

Spotahome is the safest way to book mid- to long-term accommodation in Europe, directly from your mobile phone. The homes advertised on our site are personally visited by one of our Homecheckers, professional photographers who take high-quality photos, create an HD video tour, detailed ﬂoor plans and honest descriptions of the property and neighbourhood. The most complete property listings mean that you can view, choose and book your property directly online, and enjoy a discount on the booking fee with your partner promo code.
Once the booking request has been submitted, we will forward it to the landlord, who has 24 working hours to respond. When the landlord accepts your booking, we will conﬁrm it to you via email and share your details with them and vice versa. At this time we will also take payment for the ﬁrst month’s rent and booking fee automatically. If the landlord does not accept your booking, we will offer you similar accommodation options or alternatively you may also choose a full refund.

reference_excerpts.value: Learning Agreement – the document with the selected courses at VMU. First, check the course catalogue for more information. Note: You may select the courses almost from all the VMU faculties/academies. The exception applies to art/music area courses. They are available only to the students majoring in art/music. Pay attention to the location, as courses are offered in two cities: Kaunas and Vilnius. The required amount of credits is 24 - 36 ECTS per semester. Second , list the courses in the form of the Learning Agreement , sign it and ask your home university's international programme coordinator to sign it. Third , list the selected (and confirmed by your home university) courses in your online application form ( follow the application instructions sent via e-mail after your home university nominates you ). Fourth, attach the signed Learning Agreement to your online application form ( follow the application instructions sent via e-mail after your home university nominates you ).

host_deadline.value: What is the cost of Winter Break Housing? Students can view all housing rates on our room and board rates webpage . No meal plan will be available for the winter session. Information on whether or not a Dining location will be open in the Student Center will be forthcoming. When is the application deadline for Winter Break Housing? Applications need to be submitted through MyHousing by 11:59pm on Sunday, November 30, 2025 in order for the student to move in on Monday, December 22, 2025 or  Monday, December 29th, 2025.  Applications will continue to be accepted after Sunday, November 30th, 2025, based on availability of spaces. Information on how students will be able to move into their Travers or Wolfe room will be sent to students after they apply and are assigned. Where do students live for the winter? For the winter session students may be required to consolidate in to Travers and Wolfe Halls. Specific details and instructions for winter housing locations will be provided closer to the start of this period. Is there a meal plan associated with Winter Break Housing? There will not be a meal plan associated with winter housing. Winter Break Housing residents will have ID access to the Townhouse South kitchen (within the South lounge.) Please make appropriate preparations for food over the course of your winter stay. What if I need to cancel my Winter Break Housing application? Please contact Residential Education and Housing immediately at housing@tcnj.edu to cancel your winter housing assignment. If possible all cancellations should be submitted before midnight on Monday, December 1, 2025. What if I am an athlete, international student, or housing insecure student who needs to live on campus over Winter Break? If you need to live on campus over Winter Break, you will need to apply for Winter Break Housing on MyHousing . All break housing requests can be made through the “Requests and Forms” tab on MyHousing. What if my question is not answered here? Please contact Residential Education and Housing at housing@tcnj.edu , 609-771-2301, or 609-771-3455 and we will be more than happy to assist you with any questions you have.

Students living on campus for the upcoming Fall semester that are here for Session 3 will be asked to move in to that assignment early. Please contact Residential Education and Housing immediately at housing@tcnj.edu to cancel your winter housing assignment. If possible all cancellations should be submitted before midnight on Monday, December 1, 2025. What if I am an athlete, international student, or housing insecure student who needs to live on campus over Winter Break? If you need to live on campus over Winter Break, you will need to apply for Winter Break Housing on MyHousing . All break housing requests can be made through the “Requests and Forms” tab on MyHousing. What if my question is not answered here? Please contact Residential Education and Housing at housing@tcnj.edu , 609-771-2301, or 609-771-3455 and we will be more than happy to assist you with any questions you have.

reference_excerpts.value: What is the cost of Winter Break Housing? Students can view all housing rates on our room and board rates webpage . No meal plan will be available for the winter session. Information on whether or not a Dining location will be open in the Student Center will be forthcoming. When is the application deadline for Winter Break Housing? Applications need to be submitted through MyHousing by 11:59pm on Sunday, November 30, 2025 in order for the student to move in on Monday, December 22, 2025 or  Monday, December 29th, 2025.  Applications will continue to be accepted after Sunday, November 30th, 2025, based on availability of spaces. Information on how students will be able to move into their Travers or Wolfe room will be sent to students after they apply and are assigned. Where do students live for the winter? For the winter session students may be required to consolidate in to Travers and Wolfe Halls. Specific details and instructions for winter housing locations will be provided closer to the start of this period. Is there a meal plan associated with Winter Break Housing? There will not be a meal plan associated with winter housing. Winter Break Housing residents will have ID access to the Townhouse South kitchen (within the South lounge.) Please make appropriate preparations for food over the course of your winter stay. What if I need to cancel my Winter Break Housing application? Please contact Residential Education and Housing immediately at housing@tcnj.edu to cancel your winter housing assignment. If possible all cancellations should be submitted before midnight on Monday, December 1, 2025. What if I am an athlete, international student, or housing insecure student who needs to live on campus over Winter Break? If you need to live on campus over Winter Break, you will need to apply for Winter Break Housing on MyHousing . All break housing requests can be made through the “Requests and Forms” tab on MyHousing. What if my question is not answered here? Please contact Residential Education and Housing at housing@tcnj.edu , 609-771-2301, or 609-771-3455 and we will be more than happy to assist you with any questions you have.

reference_excerpts.value: What is the cost of Winter Break Housing? Students can view all housing rates on our room and board rates webpage . No meal plan will be available for the winter session. Information on whether or not a Dining location will be open in the Student Center will be forthcoming. When is the application deadline for Winter Break Housing? Applications need to be submitted through MyHousing by 11:59pm on Sunday, November 30, 2025 in order for the student to move in on Monday, December 22, 2025 or  Monday, December 29th, 2025.  Applications will continue to be accepted after Sunday, November 30th, 2025, based on availability of spaces. Information on how students will be able to move into their Travers or Wolfe room will be sent to students after they apply and are assigned. Where do students live for the winter? For the winter session students may be required to consolidate in to Travers and Wolfe Halls. Specific details and instructions for winter housing locations will be provided closer to the start of this period. Is there a meal plan associated with Winter Break Housing? There will not be a meal plan associated with winter housing. Winter Break Housing residents will have ID access to the Townhouse South kitchen (within the South lounge.) Please make appropriate preparations for food over the course of your winter stay. What if I need to cancel my Winter Break Housing application? Please contact Residential Education and Housing immediately at housing@tcnj.edu to cancel your winter housing assignment. If possible all cancellations should be submitted before midnight on Monday, December 1, 2025. What if I am an athlete, international student, or housing insecure student who needs to live on campus over Winter Break? If you need to live on campus over Winter Break, you will need to apply for Winter Break Housing on MyHousing . All break housing requests can be made through the “Requests and Forms” tab on MyHousing. What if my question is not answered here? Please contact Residential Education and Housing at housing@tcnj.edu , 609-771-2301, or 609-771-3455 and we will be more than happy to assist you with any questions you have.

reference_excerpts.value: TCNJ offers substance free housing, on an as-needed basis. For students who are interested in this living option, a substance-free environment is defined as one where the following is prohibited: all use of tobacco (including hookah, e-cigs, pipes, cigars and cigarettes), alcohol, illegal drugs, cannabis/cannabis-type products or the misuse/abuse of prescription drugs. Additionally, neither residents nor their guests may return to the environment under the influence of any of the aforementioned substances.

housing.value:
When students live on campus, they meet each other, study together, and attend UNC Greensboro programs and events together. Most of all, they support and motivate each other. First-year Spartans live in traditional housing because it is the perfect place for incoming students to connect with other newcomers.
You can work or play on your devices anywhere in the residence halls at no extra cost. Wireless is available in your room, in a study lounge, in a parlor. You can save on mobile data charges. We have technology staff members in HRL ready to help.
Current campus residents are those students who currently live in campus housing and want to apply to live on campus the following year (No Spring Only Application).
You will use Artemis to access everything related to your housing assignment. You will apply, choose or find your room assignment and view your roommate(s)’ information, find room change information, and more! Log in using your iSpartan credentials, and you will see information that is custom-tailored just for you.

We know that for some of you, moving away from home may seem like a daunting prospect; that’s why at Essex we try our hardest to help you settle in, starting by * guaranteeing accommodation for the duration of your course, *T&C's apply . Giving our students the opportunity to live at the heart of a vibrant community with shared values and diverse interest, in an environment where you will succeed.
If you are paying your own tuition fees, you should also ensure that you have sufficient funds to pay your first term's fees. In addition, contactless payment methods are accepted across the whole campus and contactless is our preferred payment method.

host_language.value:
IELTS／TOEFL iBT®／TOEFL ITP® 注意：TOEICは留学出願には使えないことが多い。
How？ どのように学び、 成長したい？ ・帰国後にIELTSのスコアを伸ばす！ （例 5.5→7.0） ・専門科目を履修して帰国後に単位認定を目指す！ ・インターンシップでビジネス英語を習得！
There are six levels of Japanese courses which are designed to accommodate the various proficiency levels of the students. The motto of Seikei University is to provide our international students with smaller classes, from a range of 10 pupils or less, which presents an ideal language learning environment. The curriculum includes required subjects that provide overall improvement in the four skills of reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Apart from the required subjects, there are electives such as ,"Tadoku" where there is an opportunity to read a variety of easy Japanese books, and other courses include, "Business Japanese" "Japanese-Language Proficiency Test" "Creating Drama" and "Japanese Affairs."
I am aware of the fact that each exchange student has had a different experience of Japanese instruction. This is a point I keep in mind when I am instructing. I also offer advice about the courses they register with consideration for their future plans. With this in mind, the classes at Seikei University with the exchange students are held mostly with a maximum of 10 students per class. I believe that this number is an ideal amount for a language learning environment. The required subjects' aims are to get the students to improve their skills comprehensively of listening, speaking, reading and writing. These courses are designed for the students of intermediate and advanced levels. The students can also take electives that they are interested in and that match their levels. These are the subjects which make Seikei University's Japanese courses unique. We have lectures tailored for taking the Japanese Language Proficiency Test, and most students pass the test before completing their studies here. In addition to Japanese subjects, "Japanese Affairs" is one of the popular classes. It allows the students to have the opportunity to look at Japan through a variety of lenses, which includes topics such as, politics, economics, society, sports, entertainment and international relations. Please join us here at Seikei University, and I look forward to your arrival here in Japan.

reference_excerpts.value: I am aware of the fact that each exchange student has had a different experience of Japanese instruction. This is a point I keep in mind when I am instructing. I also offer advice about the courses they register with consideration for their future plans. With this in mind, the classes at Seikei University with the exchange students are held mostly with a maximum of 10 students per class. I believe that this number is an ideal amount for a language learning environment. The required subjects' aims are to get the students to improve their skills comprehensively of listening, speaking, reading and writing. These courses are designed for the students of intermediate and advanced levels. The students can also take electives that they are interested in and that match their levels. These are the subjects which make Seikei University's Japanese courses unique. We have lectures tailored for taking the Japanese Language Proficiency Test, and most students pass the test before completing their studies here. In addition to Japanese subjects, "Japanese Affairs" is one of the popular classes. It allows the students to have the opportunity to look at Japan through a variety of lenses, which includes topics such as, politics, economics, society, sports, entertainment and international relations. Please join us here at Seikei University, and I look forward to your arrival here in Japan.

Although there are student dormitories operated by local governments and universities, approximately 70% of international students live in private houses or apartments/condominiums. It is advised that you begin doing research on accommodation as soon as you receive notification of your acceptance to the university. You can find information regarding accommodation 1) at the school's international student office, 2) online, or 3) by checking with real estate agents in the area you wish to live in.
Chiba University International House is an off-campus dormitory for international students. The International House is located within walking distance from JR Inage Station, which is just one station away (2 minutes by train) from the Nishi-Chiba campus. Many students commute to the campus by bicycle (10-15 minutes). It provides rooms for singles, married couples, and families. For more details, visit ISD website

You can choose between a publicly owned building or a private one, and between a student residence or an apartment that you may occupy alone, with other students, or with a family or local resident. Don’t panic! We’ll decode the various types of housing available to students and help you in your search.
And don’t forget to ask the staff at your educational institution if they can help. Some institutions (especially the Grandes Ecoles ), maintain a stock of housing or have a system for connecting their students with housing providers.
If you have the student status (as a doctoral student), you can ask for accommodation in a student residence . Don't wait until the last second before asking.

housing_costs.value:
The residences managed by France’s regional centers for student services, known as CROUS ( centres régionaux des œuvres universitaires et scolaires ), are publicly owned and subsidized by the French government. CROUS buildings are the first choice of many students for the advantages they offer : the monthly rent is low (€450 in Paris; €350 on average elsewhere in France). The buildings are close to campus, and the opportunities for social interaction with other students are plentiful. In fact, the only drawback to CROUS rooms is that they are hard to get, because demand far exceeds supply.
4. Lokaviz lists all of the units available in CROUS residences, as well as space offered by individual property owners. There’s no cost to review the posted vacancies. All of the units listed on the site have earned the Lokaviz label, so students can be sure they’re renting decent housing .
Compare what the different banks offer. The costs of the bank card, international transfers and cash withdrawals abroad may vary noticeably from one bank to another.
Vélib’ in Paris, Vélov’ in Lyon and Vélo Bleu in Nice: most big French cities have self-service bicycle rental. An annual subscription – between 15 and 30 euros on average – is the easiest way to use it.

insurance.value:
Social Security provides foreign students with social coverage while studying in France. To increase the amount of their healthcare expenses that is reimbursed, they may take out complementary health insurance, or mutuelle.
Students with the nationality of a country from the European Union, from Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland have access to the European Health Insurance Card (EHIC). They don't need to register for French Student Social Security. This card must be requested in your country of origin and be valid until at least the end of the academic year.
Counselling centres, called Bureaux d’aide psychologique universitaires (BAPU, University Counselling Offices), welcome students in need of psychological assistance to meet with professionals such as psychotherapists and social workers. These consultations are 100% covered by health insurance and mutual insurance companies.
Apply for a health insurance card ("carte Vitale")

housing_costs.value:
交換留学制度により、明学とUCは相互に授業料免除の約束をしております。これにより、交換留学に参加する留学生は、所定の学納金を所属大学に収めていれば、留学先大学への授業料の支払いが免除されます。一般にUCを始めアメリカの大学の授業料は高額ですが、明学生であれば交換留学に参加することにより、UCの授業料が不要になるのは大きなメリットと言えます。※授業料以外の諸経費(寮費、生活費、書籍費、保険料など)は自己負担となります。

living_costs.value:
交換留学制度により、明学とUCは相互に授業料免除の約束をしております。これにより、交換留学に参加する留学生は、所定の学納金を所属大学に収めていれば、留学先大学への授業料の支払いが免除されます。一般にUCを始めアメリカの大学の授業料は高額ですが、明学生であれば交換留学に参加することにより、UCの授業料が不要になるのは大きなメリットと言えます。※授業料以外の諸経費(寮費、生活費、書籍費、保険料など)は自己負担となります。

reference_excerpts.value: 交換留学制度により、明学とUCは相互に授業料免除の約束をしております。これにより、交換留学に参加する留学生は、所定の学納金を所属大学に収めていれば、留学先大学への授業料の支払いが免除されます。一般にUCを始めアメリカの大学の授業料は高額ですが、明学生であれば交換留学に参加することにより、UCの授業料が不要になるのは大きなメリットと言えます。※授業料以外の諸経費(寮費、生活費、書籍費、保険料など)は自己負担となります。

reference_excerpts.value: 交換留学制度により、明学とUCは相互に授業料免除の約束をしております。これにより、交換留学に参加する留学生は、所定の学納金を所属大学に収めていれば、留学先大学への授業料の支払いが免除されます。一般にUCを始めアメリカの大学の授業料は高額ですが、明学生であれば交換留学に参加することにより、UCの授業料が不要になるのは大きなメリットと言えます。※授業料以外の諸経費(寮費、生活費、書籍費、保険料など)は自己負担となります。

housing.value:
At SCU, we recognise that where you live can shape your university experience - including your wellbeing, friendships, academic success and sense of belonging. That’s why we offer safe, inclusive UniLodge accommodation at our Lismore and Coffs Harbour campuses, and provide information on trusted external housing options for students at our Gold Coast campus.
A range of on-campus accommodation options are available at residential colleges across the Lismore and Coffs Harbour campuses. Apartments are modern and fully furnished, with their own kitchen, lounge, dining area and bathroom.

host_nomination_deadline.value:
Nomination deadline: April 15, 2026 - no late nominations will be accepted.
President’s International Scholarship of Excellence A select number of these scholarships are awarded per year, valued at $45,000/year. It is renewable for an additional three years of full-time undergraduate study if the student maintains good academic standing each year, bringing it to a total of $180,000 over four years. To be considered for this this award, you must submit the International Student Scholarship & Award Application. This award is for applicants with an exceptional academic profile, and who demonstrate leadership through community service or excellence in the arts or sport. Students do not need an offer of admission to apply for York entrance awards and scholarships. Important dates: The Fall/Winter 2026-2027 application will open on November 1,  2026 . Student Application Deadline: January 26, 2027 Nomination Deadline: February 4, 2027 Full details will be available in the International Student Scholarship & Award Application form when it opens in November. Note: A 9-digit York reference number is required, which you will receive within 5 business days of applying to York. Ensure that you submit your application for admission well in advance of the scholarship application deadline January 26, 2026 . For more information - President's International Scholarship of Excellence

Course fees shown are estimates only and are subject to change. Fees are based on the number of courses in which you are enrolled (except Bachelor of Design). All costs are in Canadian dollars. To convert fees into other currencies, access the Bank of Canada converter. Approximate Tuition These fees are estimated annual costs for a full-time student enrolled in fall/winter 2026-2027. For a detailed breakdown for a specific program, visit the Course and Program Fees webpage . Visit the Student Financial Services website to determine which tuition fee category is applicable to you. Average Costs by Program INTERNATIONAL Tuition and Ancillary Fees Books and Fees Most programs (Arts and Sciences) $38,465 $1,415 Business $42,819 $2,552 Commerce $41,531 $1,658 Computer Science $36,955 $1,438 Design $39,563 $2,332 Engineering $46,064 $2,018 Fees listed are approximate values based on a typical courseload. The number of courses that you take in each year are subject to vary depending on your academic program and schedule. *Approximate tuition total is based on 36 credits taken in Engineering first year. Tuition fees are based on an average for the current academic year and are subject to change. For detailed fees, visit the Course and Program Fees page. Books and Fees is based on OSAP cost codes. Notes Domestic Fees - To be eligible for domestic fees you must be either a Canadian citizen, a permanent resident of Canada (otherwise known as landed immigrant) or an exempted international student or a dependent, effective on the dates specified on an annual basis. Tuition rates for domestic out-of-province student tuition are based on your province of residence. International Fees - Students who do not have the status specified above, or who apply to York and declare themselves as visa students will be charged tuition fees at international rates. You can find more detailed information on fee categories and eligibility criteria on the Academic Tuition Fee Categories website.

reference_excerpts.value: President’s International Scholarship of Excellence A select number of these scholarships are awarded per year, valued at $45,000/year. It is renewable for an additional three years of full-time undergraduate study if the student maintains good academic standing each year, bringing it to a total of $180,000 over four years. To be considered for this this award, you must submit the International Student Scholarship & Award Application. This award is for applicants with an exceptional academic profile, and who demonstrate leadership through community service or excellence in the arts or sport. Students do not need an offer of admission to apply for York entrance awards and scholarships. Important dates: The Fall/Winter 2026-2027 application will open on November 1,  2026 . Student Application Deadline: January 26, 2027 Nomination Deadline: February 4, 2027 Full details will be available in the International Student Scholarship & Award Application form when it opens in November. Note: A 9-digit York reference number is required, which you will receive within 5 business days of applying to York. reference_excerpts.value: Course fees shown are estimates only and are subject to change. Fees are based on the number of courses in which you are enrolled (except Bachelor of Design). All costs are in Canadian dollars. To convert fees into other currencies, access the Bank of Canada converter. Approximate Tuition These fees are estimated annual costs for a full-time student enrolled in fall/winter 2026-2027. For a detailed breakdown for a specific program, visit the Course and Program Fees webpage . Visit the Student Financial Services website to determine which tuition fee category is applicable to you. Average Costs by Program INTERNATIONAL Tuition and Ancillary Fees Books and Fees Most programs (Arts and Sciences) $38,465 $1,415 Business $42,819 $2,552 Commerce $41,531 $1,658 Computer Science $36,955 $1,438 Design $39,563 $2,332 Engineering $46,064 $2,018 Fees listed are approximate values based on a typical courseload. The number of courses that you take in each year are subject to vary depending on your academic program and schedule. *Approximate tuition total is based on 36 credits taken in Engineering first year. Tuition fees are based on an average for the current academic year and are subject to change. For detailed fees, visit the Course and Program Fees page. Books and Fees is based on OSAP cost codes. Notes Domestic Fees - To be eligible for domestic fees you must be either a Canadian citizen, a permanent resident of Canada (otherwise known as landed immigrant) or an exempted international student or a dependent, effective on the dates specified on an annual basis. Tuition rates for domestic out-of-province student tuition are based on your province of residence. International Fees - Students who do not have the status specified above, or who apply to York and declare themselves as visa students will be charged tuition fees at international rates. You can find more detailed information on fee categories and eligibility criteria on the Academic Tuition Fee Categories website.

housing.value:
Spring 2027 exchange students can find the details of accommodation application on this page.
Students interested in opting out of KGU-Arranged accommodations should carefully read the Advice to Self-Arranged Accommodation Students before making a final decision.
Although there are student dormitories operated by local governments and universities, approximately 70% of international students live in private houses or apartments/condominiums. It is advised that you begin doing research on accommodation as soon as you receive notification of your acceptance to the university. You can find information regarding accommodation 1) at the school's international student office, 2) online, or 3) by checking with real estate agents in the area you wish to live in.
There are three dormitories for male students—Keimeiryo, Seishuryo, and Seizenryo.

host_language.value:
The university offers an undergraduate program in “Chinese L anguage”, speci fically designed to recruit and cultivate international talents in Chinese studies . The curriculum emphasizes enhancing students’ practical Chinese language proficiency , integrating traditional Chinese culture and national conditions, and combining fundamental theoretical knowledge of the language . After four years of study, students will achieve a high level of Chinese proficiency , obtain the HSK Level 5 certificate , and gain an in-depth understanding of traditional Chinese culture. They will become international ly competitive, application-oriented Chinese language professionals who are well-acquainted with China’s national conditions and cultural background, process strong cross-cultural communication skills , and meet the demands of modern society.
( V ) Language Proficiency Requirements for Admission:
学 校设有 “汉语言”本科专业， 专项招收培养国际中文人才。课程内容注重提升学生中文运用能力，融入中国传统文化与国情课程，兼具基础汉语理论知识。学生通过四年学习将具备较高的中文水平，获得汉语水平五级证书 (HSK 5)，同时沉浸式接受中国传统文化熏陶，成为熟悉中国国情和文化背景、具备较强中外跨文化交际能力、适应现代社会需求的国际化应用型中文人才。
原则上不做中文水平要求，已获得 HSK4级以上证书者优先推荐留学生奖学金。毕业于 马来西亚华文独立中学（以中国驻马来西亚大使馆认证为准）毕业者， 无需汉语水平证书 。高中阶段以中文作为授课语言的申请者，可凭高中出具的授课证明做作为代替。

2.能够负担在 福州大学 期间的所有个人生活费用，包括教材或书本费、交通费、住宿费、医疗和健康保险费、餐费等其他费用。
1. Accommodation F ee: The university arranges on-campus dormitories for international students, primarily double rooms at RMB 3,500 per year at the beginning of the academic year. Accommodation fees for the standard duration of study for scholarship recipients are covered by the university. Self-funded students pay their own accommodation fees.
Applicants may simultaneously apply for the Fujian Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students and the Fuzhou University Scholarship for International Students. No additional materials are needed. The university will select scholarship candidates from the admitted students based on merit and submit the list to the university and the relevant scholarship authorities for approval. These two scholarships offer identical benefits: tuition, accommodation fee, and insurance premium are covered by the scholarship funds. Students also receive a living allowance .

UMA does NOT offer accommodation to students , but offers help in finding accommodation through the International Hub, the Accommodation Service or ESN Malaga.
The Social Action Service of the University of Malaga has an Accommodation Programme with the aim of enabling the search for rented housing through online access to the computer application created for this purpose, where all the formalities are carried out completely FREE of charge, both for those interested in looking for accommodation and for landlords who offer their homes to the university community.

host_language.value:
深草学舎和顔館にあるグローバルコモンズでは、TOEFL®、IELTS™問題集等をランゲージスタディエリアにそろえています。スピーキングブースでは、シャドウイングもできます。語学学習をサポートする様々な設備を備え、イベント等も行っていますので、ぜひグローバルコモンズを利用して、留学準備に役立てていきましょう。
英語圏の場合は、TOEFL®、IELTS™問題集を解いてみましょう。その他の言語については、グローバル教育推進センターで過去問題を閲覧できます｡過去の傾向を調べ､苦手な分野を集中して勉強してみるのもよいでしょう｡目標値を定め､自分の学習計画を立てましょう｡

交換留学とは、本学の学生交換協定校へ龍谷大学の代表として派遣されるもので、学費の免除はもちろん、協定校によっては奨学金を受けることも可能な制度です。原則として毎年同数の学生を派遣・受け入れしています。
留学期間は原則1年間または半年間です。その間の龍谷大学の学費も免除となりますが、留学在籍料が必要です。なお、留学先大学の都合により、年度途中であっても、条件が変更になる場合や、募集を行わない場合がありますので、最新の情報はグローバル教育推進センターホームページで確認して下さい。

housing.value:
Hanwoori House, opened in February 1999, is located at a place with the most spectacular view in our campus. The dormitory consists of Building 101 for undergraduate students, Building 102 (Soseul-gwan) for students who study for state examination and Building 103 which opened in February 2016. Hanwoori House can accommodate approximately 1,330 residents and it plays an important role in cultivating intercultural communication and ewhaen spirit among residents.
Soseul-gwan is a dormitory for ewhaen Law School students, preparing for the bar exam to be laywers and leaders. With about 130 single rooms and 110 double rooms, Soseul-gwan consist of various facilities such as reading room, study room, seminar room, auditory room and computer room. Providing the superior academic environment, Soseul-gwan offers the best support for the future legal experts.
If you decide to study in Korea, it’s important to explore the various housing options available. Find your ideal living environment and contract type through apps that
				provide detailed information.

living_costs.value:
Most universities operate their own dormitories. Dormitories are located on campus or within a relatively short distance, making them convenient for commuting and relatively affordable. Additionally, dormitories are equipped with various facilities such as libraries, computer labs, gyms, and dining halls, offering a range of conveniences for students. However, dormitories are shared living spaces, so privacy is limited, and strict living rules are enforced. Rooms are typically categorized into single, double, or quadruple occupancy. The conditions for admission and living costs vary by university, so it is recommended to inquire with your
											school’s dormitory office.

reference_excerpts.value: 进入国际教育学院网站... 西安交通大学留学生教育始于 1959 年，是教育部指定的最早培养中国政府奖学金留学生的院校之一。 1991 年组建对外汉语教学的专门机构，开展对外汉语教学项目； 1999 年设立西安交通大学留学生奖学金。 2007 年设立留学生汉语言本科专业。 2013 年，基于我校在留学生规模、结构、质量、管理、发展速度等方面的优异表现，教育部授予我校全国“首批来华留学示范基地”荣誉。 2016 年，以优异成绩通过国家首批来华留学质量认证。 西安交通大学医学留学生教育始于 1995 年，是首创全英文授课培养医学本科留学生的院校， 2000 年开创了全英文授课医学硕士教育。自 1995 年以来，已经培养了来自 63 个国家的医学留学生 2000 余名，毕业生规模居全国之首。 2005 年受教育部委托起草制定了《来华留学生医学本科教育（英文授课）质量控制标准暂行规定》。 截止 2020 年，西安交通大学留学生规模达 2891 名，分别来自于 134 个生源国家。其中学历生 2659 人，本科 1106 人，硕士 893 人，博士 660 人。 全校留学生工作的综合管理部门是国际教育学院。国际教育学院成立于 2006 年，同时也是开展留学生教育的办学实体。学院主要职责为：负责学校外国留学生工作相关政策的制定与监督执行；负责留学生的招生、出入境与后勤保障等管理工作；负责留学生的日常教育与管理，协调学历留学生教务工作；开展留学生汉语言本科专业的教学与学科建设工作，并负责各类留学生汉语课程的教学工作。 一直以来，国际教育学院严格按照教育部“扩大规模、优化结构、规范管理、保证质量”的方针，致力于发展西安交通大学的留学生教育，全力做好留学生教育管理与汉语教学工作，为实现西安交通大学留学生事业的快速发展和建设世界知名高水平大学贡献力量！

evidence.quote: 西安交通大学留学生教育始于 1959 年，是教育部指定的最早培养中国政府奖学金留学生的院校之一。 1991 年组建对外汉语教学的专门机构，开展对外汉语教学项目； 1999 年设立西安交通大学留学生奖学金。 2007 年设立留学生汉语言本科专业。 2013 年，基于我校在留学生规模、结构、质量、管理、发展速度等方面的优异表现，教育部授予我校全国“首批来华留学示范基地”荣誉。 2016 年，以优异成绩通过国家首批来华留学质量认证。

reference_excerpts.value: 处长: 刘文凤 电话: 82665004 e-mail: liuwenfeng@xjtu.edu.cn 处办: 科学馆 114室 电话: 82668830 进入国际合作与交流处... 西安交通大学国际合作与交流处是学校开展对外合作与交流工作的归口管理和服务部门。设有交流管理办公室、项目管理办公室和出入境管理办公室。港澳台事务办公室设置在国际合作与交流处。 其主要职责是： 1.建立和保持西安交通大学与境外大学、教育机构和有关单位的联系与合作； 2.接待来自世界各国的访问学者和外籍友人，负责来校工作的长短期外国专家来华工作许可及相关邀请函办理； 3.负责各级各类国际合作与交流项目的申报和管理； 4.归口管理中外合作办学机构和项目； 5.校际交流协议的签署及合作与交流项目的开发与管理； 6.授予国际知名人士和学者荣誉学衔； 7.国际会议的申报和管理； 8.办理校内人员因公长、短期出国（出境）手续； 9.招收和培养港澳台地区学生，负责港澳台学生的相关涉外事务和日常管理，处理与港澳台地区合作交流方面的事务。

TJU will provide on campus accommodation for exchange students. The rate is about 60 rmb/night. Both Weijin Road Campus and Peiyang Park Campus of Tianjin University have international student dormitories. The campus allocation for international students is uniformly arranged by the university based on the current year's policies and the location of the campus of the international student's major. International students need to reserve online. If they are unable to reserve accommodation on campus successfully, the university will provide off campus accommodation information for students to choose from. Please pay attention to the internal notifications of Tianjin University International Student Service System for details . The introduction for accommodation can be download below.

台湾居民在大陆向出入境管理机构申请换发或补发台湾居民来往大陆通行证时，发现其未办理住宿登记。

transport.value:
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。
1927年，李书田应北洋大学校长刘仙洲之邀返校任教，讲授土木工程专业的课程，开始了他长达近60年的教育生涯。李书田重视教学与科研相结合，除了在北洋任教外，还担任华北水利委员会的委员兼秘书长一职。1930年，李书田到交通大学唐山土木工程学院任院长，到校不及一年就为该校添设了矿冶工程系和研究院，促进了唐山地区的科研事业。1931年4月，在李书田的努力下，中国水利工程学会得以建立，他任该学会副会长。1932年9月，李书田任北洋工学院（北洋大学当时的校名）院长。此后5年间，他为学校发展做了大量卓有成效的工作：学校的工程学馆、工程实验馆、新图书馆相继竣工并投入使用；学校多种学术期刊蓬勃发展；重新创作了校歌；各系增设了近20个实验室，增添了设备；1935年，学校创办“工科研究所”，开创了研究生培养的先河，使北洋工学院成为国内高校中最早招收研究生的大学之一；他力促建成了“天津水工实验所”，后改称“中国第一水工实验所”。1937年2月，李书田制定了《国立北洋大学筹备缘起及分期完成计划》，提出了用16年时间，将北洋大学建设成为工理文法医相结合的综合性一流大学的奋斗目标。

reference_excerpts.value: 1927年，李书田应北洋大学校长刘仙洲之邀返校任教，讲授土木工程专业的课程，开始了他长达近60年的教育生涯。李书田重视教学与科研相结合，除了在北洋任教外，还担任华北水利委员会的委员兼秘书长一职。1930年，李书田到交通大学唐山土木工程学院任院长，到校不及一年就为该校添设了矿冶工程系和研究院，促进了唐山地区的科研事业。1931年4月，在李书田的努力下，中国水利工程学会得以建立，他任该学会副会长。1932年9月，李书田任北洋工学院（北洋大学当时的校名）院长。此后5年间，他为学校发展做了大量卓有成效的工作：学校的工程学馆、工程实验馆、新图书馆相继竣工并投入使用；学校多种学术期刊蓬勃发展；重新创作了校歌；各系增设了近20个实验室，增添了设备；1935年，学校创办“工科研究所”，开创了研究生培养的先河，使北洋工学院成为国内高校中最早招收研究生的大学之一；他力促建成了“天津水工实验所”，后改称“中国第一水工实验所”。1937年2月，李书田制定了《国立北洋大学筹备缘起及分期完成计划》，提出了用16年时间，将北洋大学建设成为工理文法医相结合的综合性一流大学的奋斗目标。

reference_excerpts.value: The layout of the Students’ Dormitory Buildings at Peiyangyuan Campus is designed with a focus on student welfare. The 24 enclosed buildings are strategically located around academic facilities and near dining halls, supermarkets, and other essential services, housing approximately 20,000 students. The dormitory buildings form a courtyard that encloses all four sides. The names of each building—Ge Yuan, Zhi Yuan （知园） , Cheng Yuan, Zheng Yuan, Xiu Yuan, Qi Yuan, Zhi Yuan （治园） , and Ping Yuan—are derived from the eight steps for self-perfection as outlined in The Book of Rites and The Great Learning . These steps include learning from nature (gewu), pursuing the truth (zhizhi), remaining honest to one’s heart (chengyi), practicing temperance (zhengxin), perfecting one’s personality (xiushen), harmonizing one’s family (qijia), managing one’s country (zhiguo), and restoring peace to the world (pingtianxia).

transport.value:
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。
温馨提示：国庆节期间，交通出行压力巨大，请大家提前做好规划，尽量不去人多的地方，注意人身财产安全！
4.遵守交通法规，注意交通安全。不得骑行摩托车。电瓶车行驶不超速、不超载、骑自行车不逆行行驶、不闯红灯。驾驶电动车时，遇到车辆故障或途中制动失效时，应当下车推行。

transport.value:
中国实行右侧通行，机动车驾驶位在左侧。行人需在人行道内行走，电动自行车、电动三轮车等需登记后方可上路行驶。乘坐公共交通时，公交车遵循 “前门上车、后门下车” 规则，地铁内禁止大声喧哗和饮食。建议通过《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》官网查询详细规定。​
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

insurance.value:
National Health Insurance 2,000 yen
All foreign nationals with a residence permit for a period exceeding 3 months who are students or who are not covered by an employer’s social security plan (mutual aid, health insurance) are required to join National Health Insurance. By paying monthly premiums, subscribers are required to cover only 30% of their medical expenses.
National Health Insurance is especially beneficial in cases of serious disease or hospitalization thanks to its reimbursement system: if the total sum of medical bills that a single medical institution charges to a subscriber within 1 month exceeds a certain amount, the excess sum is reimbursed to the subscriber.

living_costs.value:
International students are required to show tuition for 2 academic semesters +  estimated living expenses of $15,000 + $8700 in estimated fees for books,  health insurance and supplies etc. To determine your estimated fees:
Regardless of whether you live on campus or off  campus, you will have living expenses. This includes rent, utilities,  groceries, etc.    Living expenses are currently estimated at $15,000.00 per year. This sum must be added to the tuition and fees listed at https://bursar.temple.edu/tuition-and-fees/tuition-rates .
If you have a friend or family member who will be supplying room and board, they can complete the form available at https://isss.temple.edu/file/room-and-board-affidavitpdf. That form should be uploaded  and will  cover the estimated living expenses of $15,00.00. You would be responsible for provided financial documentation that covered the tuition and the estimated fees for  books, insuract etc which are set at $4,000.00

You can catch the free UQ Intercampus bus from the St Lucia campus – Chancellors Place, to the Gatton campus (runs four times per day Monday to Friday only). You must book a seat at least one (1) business day before your journey, using your UQ Student ID number as reference. Please refer to the current UQ Intercampus Bus Timetable when planning your journey (refer to the West Bound, St Lucia to Gatton service when travelling to Gatton).

As a benefit of living on campus, residents will have $100,000 in liability insurance provided for them through SF State and GradGuard. This liability coverage is included in your housing fees and protects you financially in the event you cause unintentional damage to your room or apartment due to fire, smoke, explosion, or the discharge of a sprinkler head.
To cancel a housing application or decline a space prior to the fee period, applicants are required to provide a 15-day cancellation notice in order to receive a refund of the initial payment. Applicants who have not yet submitted the initial payment may cancel at any time.

housing.value:
Welcome to the Hawaiʻi Pacific University ʻohana! I'm Marquet, Director of Housing, and I'm genuinely glad your student has chosen to call HPU home this year.
1. Submit Your Intent to Enroll Form and $200 Enrollment Deposit (if newly enrolled) *We recommend submitting your Enrollment Deposit AT LEAST 48 hours in advance of when you plan to access the Housing Application
2. Submit Your Housing Application and $400 Housing Deposit
Harbor Lofts is our housing location for our first year students. The Executive Centre housing location is for all other student classifications.

Therefore, we encourage you to secure housing as soon as possible.

Non-residential students (whether they would have been covered by the housing guarantee or not) may be eligible for one of these beds for the remaining part of the semester or, in some cases, the remaining academic year.  Charges for such beds will be on a pro-rated basis.  Students interested in this possibility should contact Residence Life & Housing at [email protected] . Law and Graduate students interested in University-sponsored housing should contact Residence Life & Housing at [email protected] . All students in University-sponsored housing are subject to the student handbook and the provisions of the University housing agreement.

course_restrictions.value:
⁠Graduate Assistantships (GAs) are paid positions at UW-Stout Polytechnic where you also have the opportunity to gain valuable professional experience. The process for finding a GA position here is a bit different than on some campuses. Openings are posted on Handshake by academic programs and administrative units, and the process of searching for one and applying is much like finding any other kind of employment. You must meet all of the following criteria to hold a Graduate Assistantship (GA): •    admitted to a graduate degree program (dual-level and non-degree seeking students are not eligible), •    enrolled in at least six graduate credits each term, and •    maintain a GPA of at least 3.0 each term.
To remain eligible for this scholarship, recipients must renew it each semester. Renewal is contingent upon fulfilling the global involvement requirement, earning at least 15 credits per semester to maintain full-time enrollment, and maintaining a cumulative UW-Stout Polytechnic undergraduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher each semester.
To remain eligible for this scholarship, recipients must renew it each semester. Renewal is contingent upon fulfilling the global involvement requirement, earning at least 9 credits per semester to maintain full-time enrollment, and maintaining a cumulative UW-Stout Polytechnic undergraduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher each semester.

Affordability is a key factor in choosing a university. UW-Stout Polytechnic is ranked as one of the United States' most affordable public universities. Be sure to compare apples to apples when considering other schools, and examine factors such as what your tuition and residence hall fees include, on-campus employment, internships, and scholarships .
At UW-Stout Polytechnic, we provide on-campus employment opportunities and paid internships with our industry partners. As an on-campus, undergraduate student your tuition and residence hall fees include textbooks, a laptop with software, and all of the essentials for your room. Plus, we have thousands of dollars in scholarships set aside specifically for international students.
Housing staff is available by phone or video chat (on Microsoft Teams) Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
Many international students live and eat on campus. The housing contract reserves your room and meal plan for the school year, and you can also choose to live on campus during the summer ( no summer meal plan available ). Suite-style housing may be available on campus. On-campus graduate housing is most likely not available.  For some students choosing to live off campus, costs are similar, depending upon the type of apartment or shared house.

reference_excerpts.value: ⁠Graduate Assistantships (GAs) are paid positions at UW-Stout Polytechnic where you also have the opportunity to gain valuable professional experience. The process for finding a GA position here is a bit different than on some campuses. Openings are posted on Handshake by academic programs and administrative units, and the process of searching for one and applying is much like finding any other kind of employment. reference_excerpts.value: UW-Stout follows the Board of Regents' two-year live-on requirement. This policy states that students are required to live on-campus their first two years after high school graduation. Living on-campus is a great way to meet new people, get involved, and build strong academic habits. However, living in a hall with hundreds of other students can be tough, and a few established guidelines can help. Review the policies and procedures, including the details of the Housing Contract and the Code of Conduct, that affect students living on-campus.

Campus Life Art & Culture Sports & Facilities Students’ Associations Banking Campus Canteens Stores and Supermarkets Campus Accommodation Post Offices Hospitals Campus Bus Transportation
What is the most important thing in college students’ life? Apart from the romantically infused sight of cherry blossoms in spring and the wisdom imparted by teachers to the studious, commuting remains a common concern. Transportation is significant for a campus that covers 5915 acres , with teaching and living facilities scattered around. Thanks to the efforts of Wuhan University (WHU), several measures have been taken to improve students’ commute inside this large campus.
For most students, electric bicycles and school buses are the top two choices to cope with hilly streets and little travel time. However, electric bicycles are dangerous for drivers and school buses can be time-consuming. Improving measures related to these two means of transport have become one of the greatest concerns of the relevant university authorities, resulting in several changes.

transport.value:
（一）公安出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，符合签发条件的应当在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或需异地核查材料等特殊情况，不能按期签发的，经省级公安机关出入境管理机构负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日。
答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

NEWS NEWS 2026（第二届）上海高质量国际人才交流会暨HSK高校来华留学就业展举行 5月10日，由复旦大学、汉考国际联合主办的“2026（第二届）上海高质量国际人才交流会暨高校来华留学就业展”在复旦大学正大体育馆开幕。教育部中外语言交流合作中心副主任杨洲、上海市教育委员会副主任叶霖霖、复旦大学党委副书记方明、上海市出入境管理总队副总队长胡鹰、阿里国际数字商业集团Lazada执行副总裁刘歆杨等嘉宾出席开幕式。京东、阿里、小米、腾讯等50家知名企业，以及复旦大学、北京大学、清华大学、上海交通大学等近40余所全国知名高校代表，与来自世界各地的来华留学生、归国中文教师及志愿者3000多人齐聚复旦，共绘国际人才发展新图景。开幕式上，杨洲在致辞中表示，以上海为代表的中国式现代化建设持续释放活力，吸引越来越多国际青年来华发展。目前，语合中心已与全球190多个国家开展中文教育合作，支持设立83个中文学习测试中心和1477个HSK考点，年考生超81万人次，全球中文学习者达2.1亿。作为语合中心指导汉考国际打造的品牌项目，“HSK留学中国与就业展”已在51国举办200余场，服务90余万人次，帮助20余万学习者来华留学或就业。他表示，语合中心将与各界合作伙伴积极构建“标准制定——课程培训— 2026-05-12

housing_costs.value:
3. International students living in the Xianlin campus’s student dormitory should pay their room fees according to the stipulated time period. Rent may be paid by semester or by school year.
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Xianlin campus (about 60 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 50). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Xinjiekou Station and then take metro line 2(toward Jingtian Street) inside the station. Take exit 1 at Nanjing University Xianlin Campus Station. You may take a 20-minute walk to the dormitory.

transport.value:
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory
From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Xianlin campus (about 60 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 50). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Xinjiekou Station and then take metro line 2(toward Jingtian Street) inside the station. Take exit 1 at Nanjing University Xianlin Campus Station. You may take a 20-minute walk to the dormitory.

reference_excerpts.value: From Nanjing Lukou International Airport to Gulou campus (about 45 km) a. By Airport shuttle bus: Take bus line 1 to Nanjing Railway Station or take bus line 2 to Zhonghua Gate. It will cost you RMB 25. Then take a cab to the dormitory (for about RMB 22). b. By Taxi: It will cost you around RMB 150~200. c. By Subway:Take metro Airport Line(toward Nanjing South Railway Station) at Lukou Airport to Nanjing South Railway Station(7 stops). And then transfer Line 1 inside the station. Take metro line 1 (toward Maigao Qiao) to the Gulou station and then take the second exit. You may call a taxi (for about RMB 11) or take a 15-minute walk to the dormitory

housing.value:
We’re proud to be able to provide accommodation to all undergraduate students who require it. All our undergraduate freshers (first-year students) are housed on our main college site, right in the heart of Oxford. You’ll be at the centre of our college community, close to the common room and dining hall, and living alongside other new students.
Graduate applicants who receive either a conditional or unconditional offer from Hertford are invited to apply for college accommodation via a separate application form sent by the Hertford Accommodation Office.
Application process Applications are processed in three allocation rounds (normally April, May and June). Following each round, applicants will either: receive an accommodation offer; or be notified that they remain under consideration for the next round. Applicants who are unsuccessful after the final round may join a waiting list. If you have a disability or medical requirement affecting accommodation, this must be declared in your application and registered with the University’s Disability Advisory Service (DAS) so that it can be prioritised during the allocation process.

Standard licence (19 September 2026 to 13 July 2027): £8,752.59 Please note that a few properties have different licence dates, which will be advised as part of the application process. Additional nights may be available before or after the standard licence period (although this is not guaranteed) and are charged at the nightly rate. Charges increase annually on 1 August. Rent includes: all utilities basic contents insurance (provided by Howdens ) Wi-Fi Students should budget separately for laundry costs. Pay-per-use laundry facilities are available in a number of college accommodation buildings.

₩500,000–600,000 per month (living expenses exclude undergraduate tuition, dormitory fee, and Korean language course tuition)
Most universities operate their own dormitories. Dormitories are located on campus or within a relatively short distance, making them convenient for commuting and relatively affordable. Additionally, dormitories are equipped with various facilities such as libraries, computer labs, gyms, and dining halls, offering a range of conveniences for students. However, dormitories are shared living spaces, so privacy is limited, and strict living rules are enforced. Rooms are typically categorized into single, double, or quadruple occupancy. The conditions for admission and living costs vary by university, so it is recommended to inquire with your
											school’s dormitory office.

insurance.value:
Die gesetzliche Krankenversicherung in Österreich erstattet den Versicherten die Kosten für erforderliche medizinische Behandlungen. EU/EWR Staatsbürger*innen erhalten in den Ländern der EU über Ihre European Health Insurance Card (= Rückseite der ecard) ebenfalls kostenlose medizinische Versorgung für alle Behandlungen, die während des Auslandsaufenthalts medizinisch notwendig sind (Kontroll- und Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sind hiervon in der Regel ausgenommen). Sollten Sie nicht in Österreich versichert sein oder Staatsbürger*in eines Drittstaats sein, klären Sie den Auslandsversicherungsschutz bitte mit Ihrer Krankenversicherung direkt.
Erasmus+ Studierende müssen sich selbstständig um eine ausreichende Kranken- bzw. Reiseversicherung sorgen. In der Regel sind EU/EWR Staatsbürger*innen über die Europäische Krankenversicherungskarte (EHIC – European Health Insurance Card) krankenversichert. Mit der EHIC Karte erhalten Sie bei Kassenärzt*innen in Österreich kostenlose medizinische Versorgung für alle Behandlungen, die während Ihres Aufenthalts medizinisch notwendig sind . Kontroll- und Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sind hiervon ausgenommen.

２．在留資格（ビザ）オリエンテーション 出入国在留管理局への申請書類の提出や在留カードの受領は、学生本人に代わって駒澤大学が業務委託にて行っています。 日本政府により外国人政策が厳格化される中、在留資格の更新に関する重要な事項について説明します。 在留資格の更新ができなくなることもあるので、必ず参加してください。 【対象者】在留資格（ビザ）「留学」で在学する予定の人 【日　時】 2026年4月1日（水） 15：00～ 【場　所】駒沢キャンパス　1号館　1-204教場 【持ち物】 （1）筆記用具 （2）学生証（持っている人のみ） （3）パスポート （4）在留カード（交付されている人のみ） （5）スマートフォン、タブレット、またはノートパソコン 【問い合わせ】国際センター事務室 （駒沢キャンパス本部棟1階） kokusaicenter（a）komazawa-u.ac.jp ※（a）を@に変更してください。

costs.value:
交換留学においては、留学期間の属する年度の駒澤大学の学費が減免されることがあります。それだけでなく、ほとんどの派遣先大学での授業料は免除になります。何かと経済的な負担の大きい留学にとっては、大きなメリットと言えるでしょう。
４.在留資格認定証明書（ＣＯＥ）交付申請について 大学で教育を受けるために必要な在留資格（「留学」など）を有していない方は、出入国在留管理局への申請手続が必要なため2次手続（学費納入）後、3月７日（土）までに国際センターへ申し出てください。

housing_costs.value:
Understand Costs Beyond Rent: Be sure to clarify all fees, including application fees, administrative fees, security deposits, and parking fees. Ask which utilities are included and which you will be responsible for.
Tharpe: This area offers affordable housing and a quieter, residential feel. It can be a great fit for students who are proactive and prioritize a lower price point.
To be considered for an invitation to a Living–Learning Community, you must submit first your Housing Contract and $225 prepayment, then an online application for each Living–Learning Community of interest to you. Please see our Living–Learning Community webpage for additional information.
Each resident brings a different set of expectations. To encourage open communication, all residents discuss and sign a roommate agreement at the beginning of the fall term and any time there is a change in residence status in the room. When roommates are unable to resolve a situation on their own, a mediator is called upon to help. In mediation, an objective person, usually a University Housing staff member, acts as an arbitrator to ensure that strong feelings do not hinder the process and that roommates follow the rules. In the extreme cases in which mediation fails, arbitration will be used. In this process roommates agree beforehand to honor the arbitrator's decision. This binding decision may entail one or more roommates moving to another room. Students requesting to move to another room are obligated to their current room assignment until University Housing is able to find space available to accommodate the move.

transport.value:
With one of the most compact campuses in the state, it's already easy to get around Florida State. But Transportation & Parking Services has made it even easier with a variety of services. Six multi-level garages, real-time parking availability counts, and valet services mean campus parking has never been easier. Seminole Express shuttle buses will quickly get you to and around campus. During late night hours, services such as S.A.F.E. Connection, Night Nole, and Nole Cab provide transportation around campus so you won't have to walk alone. If you're looking to get off campus, FSU students ride for free on all City of Tallahassee (StarMetro) buses, or you can pick up a Zipcar at one of three campus locations and go your own way.
Yes, the University provides a bus shuttle for the campus and surrounding areas. Further information may be obtained by contacting Parking Services at (850) 644-5278, on the Transportation website .

housing.value:
CSULB's housing options offer students a convenient and supportive living environment. On-campus housing provides students with a sense of community and the opportunity to get involved in campus life. Living on campus can also help students feel more connected to the university and make it easier to access academic and other resources.
There are several different housing options available at Long Beach State University. Each option offers a different living experience and caters to different student needs and preferences.
Housing Room Rates are structured by three tiers, then by room types, based on buildings and amenities. Please be sure to check out our Room Comparison Chart (PDF) .
Step 2 - Begin housing application on the Housing Portal (accessible through your MyCSULB SSO) Application will take 15-20 minutes to complete. Due to high demand, the application portal may not be available on your first attempt. Since applications are based on distance, students can apply any date and time between April 2 and priority date of May 1st. If you are applying before May 1st, the application is not first-come, first serve . If you are experiencing portal issues, try again later.

答：一般情况下，内地公安机关出入境管理机构受理台湾居民来往大陆通行证申请后，会在7个工作日内予以签发；因所在地交通不便或者需要进一步调查核实等情况，不能按期签发的，经审批机关负责人批准，签发时间可以延长至20个工作日；台湾居民因探病、奔丧、诉讼、处理紧急商务等事由急于返回台湾的，公安机关出入境管理机构将加急办理。一般情况下，口岸公安机关出入境管理机构办理台湾居民来往大陆通行证不超过30分钟。

transport.value:
地域連携 2026.04.13 留学生が一日警察署長として活躍　地域で交通安全を呼びかけ
4月7日、「春の全国交通安全運動出動式における広報啓発活動」が、道の駅みのりの郷 東金（千葉県東金市）で開催され、国際人文学部国際交流学科の留学生であるパトリシア ロンキエビチュさんが一日警察署長として交通事故防止に向けた注意喚起の広報活動や啓発物の配布を行いました。パトリシアさんは、ポーランド ワルシャワ大学からの交換留学生として本学で学んでおり、地域との交流や日本文化への関心の高さが評価され、このたび一日警察署長に任命されました。
委嘱式終了後は、道の駅みのりの郷 東金へ移動し、来店された方々に、終始笑顔で積極的に声をかけながら啓発物を手渡し、交通安全を呼びかけました。
*シャトルバスをご利用の方は、事前のご予約が必要になります。申込フォームで「交通手段：シャトルバス」を選んでいただくと、同伴者の人数も含めて自動的に予約されます。当日のご案内をスムーズにするため、交通手段の選択にご協力ください。
